title: Vietnam takes baton from Seoul for 2028 gathering of Asia, Oceanian parties
caption:
83 parties from across Asia and Oceania gathered in Seoul and signed a joint declaration on peace, AI, climate and trust. Vietnam will host the next meeting in 2028, keeping the dialogue alive.

Source: Koreaherald - Vietnam takes baton from Seoul for 2028 gathering of Asia, Oceanian parties
